## Runs 6 + 7 — SdH spot checks at D = 0 (`sdh-spot-check`, run-5 cal)

Run 6: electron side, n = +3.2×10¹² cm⁻², B 0 → 10 T (10 mT above 1 T). Run 7: hole side,
n = −1.2×10¹², B 10 → 0.3 T (20 mT). Raw R(B), R vs 1/B, then per-window FFT in 1/B
(`sdh_fft`, three B windows for tone stability) with the full-density Luttinger frequency
F_full = |n|h/4e marked; printed: `sdh_onset` per-tone track.

"""Runs 6 & 7 — SdH spot checks at D = 0 (run-5 cal): raw R(B), then FFT in 1/B + tone onsets."""
from hera.analysis import (open_run, resolve_channels, current_channel,
                           sdh_fft, sdh_onset, luttinger_frequency)

SPOTS = [(6, +3.2e16, 'electron, n = +3.2e12 cm^-2'),   # n in SI m^-2 for luttinger_frequency
         (7, -1.2e16, 'hole, n = -1.2e12 cm^-2')]
fig, axs = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(15, 8))
for (rid, n_si, lab), ax in zip(SPOTS, axs):
    r = open_run(f'data/{rid}')
    chs = resolve_channels(r.meta); cur = current_channel(chs)
    vch = next(c for c in chs if not c.is_current)
    B, I = r.col('magnet_field'), r.col(cur.col) / cur.gain
    R = (r.col(vch.col) / vch.gain) / I
    o = np.argsort(B); B, R = B[o], R[o]
    F_L = float(luttinger_frequency(abs(n_si)))
    # raw
    ax[0].plot(B, R, lw=0.6, color='k')
    ax[0].set(xlabel='B (T)', ylabel=r'$R_{xx}$ ($\Omega$)', title=f'run {rid}: {lab} — raw')
    m = B > 1.0
    ax[1].plot(1 / B[m], R[m], lw=0.6, color='k')
    ax[1].set(xlabel='1/B (1/T)', ylabel=r'$R_{xx}$ ($\Omega$)', title='vs 1/B (B > 1 T)')
    # FFT windows + onset read
    for b_lo, c in ((2.0, 'C0'), (4.0, 'C1'), (6.0, 'C3')):
        f, sp = sdh_fft(R[:, None], B, b_range=(b_lo, B.max()))
        s1 = sp[0] / sp[0][f > 2].max()
        ax[2].plot(f, s1, c, lw=0.9, label=f'{b_lo:.0f}–{B.max():.0f} T')
    ax[2].axvline(F_L, color='0.5', ls='--', label=f'F_full = {F_L:.1f} T')
    ax[2].set(xlabel='F (T)', ylabel='norm |FFT|', xlim=(0, 60), title='SdH FFT in 1/B')
    ax[2].legend(fontsize=8)
    print(f'--- run {rid} ({lab}): F_full(4-fold) = {F_L:.1f} T ---')
    so = sdh_onset(R, B, r_full_scale=50e-6 / 10e-9)
    print(so.summary(), '\n')
fig.tight_layout()

**Read (runs 6+7, data/6 data/7):** Electron side (n = +3.2×10¹², F_full = 33.1 T): a single light fundamental **F = 7.1 T** with clean 2×/3×/4× harmonics (14.1/22.1/29.5 T), oscillating down to the 0.3 T record edge. The pocket carries 4eF/h = 0.69×10¹² ≈ **21 % of the total density** — the remaining ~79 % sits in one or more heavy bands that are LK-damped at this rig's T_e ≈ 8 K. That is a light+heavy multiband structure (ABAB- or ABCB-like); a rhombohedral (ABCA) single heavy band cannot produce a 7 T light tone at this n. Hole side (n = −1.2×10¹², F_full = 12.4 T): multi-tone — fundamentals ≈ **4.7 and 6.6 T** (each with tracked harmonics) plus **8.5 and 12.3 T**; 12.3 T ≈ F_full, a candidate full-Fermi-surface (magnetic-breakdown or single-band) orbit. Near-CNP multi-pocket landscape, branch attribution not possible from one density. **Both reads point at the same next step: F(n) — the Landau fan at D = 0 (plan step 4).**

## HERA — Step 4: Landau fan at D = 0 (`landau-fan`) — the stacking-call measurement

> **05:24** · landau-fan: D=0 line (run-5 cal), n -1.25..+3.25e12 121 pts co-swept TG/BG; B 1.2->10 T uniform-1/B 97 rows; Vsi=0; sr1 100 uV; base T · **ETA ~11:09** (≈5h45m)

Plan step 4 (operator-requested). The spot checks fix the design: e-side (run 6, data/6) shows a light F = 7.1 T pocket carrying only ~21 % of n with the rest LK-dead-heavy; h-side (run 7, data/7) is multi-tone (4.7/6.6/8.5/12.3 T). The stacking call needs **F(n)** on both signs — branch count, slopes, and density partition vs the full-density Luttinger line separate ABAB (light+heavy pair, partial slopes) from ABCA (single full-slope branch) from ABCB (light-cone + heavy remainder). **Grid:** fast axis = (V_tg, V_bg) co-swept along the calibrated D = 0 line (run-5 cal, `cal_run5.json`), n = −1.25 → +3.25×10¹² in 121 pts; slow axis = B, 1.2 → 10 T in 97 rows **uniform in 1/B** (Δ(1/B) = 7.6×10⁻³ → F_Nyquist 65 T, ΔF ≈ 1.4 T — resolves every observed tone and the 33 T ABCA discriminator). Magnet sits at 0 T → fan ascends, ends at 10 T (never re-traverse). **Coverage trade:** hole side reaches only n = −1.25×10¹² (TG −0.3 V limit on the D = 0 line) — the h-side branch read is confined to the near-CNP multi-pocket regime; B < 1.2 T is not in the fan (covered 1D by runs 6/7); full h-side coverage would need a different D or a limit change — banned. Sensitivity 100 µV (10 kΩ FS, 17× run-7's high-B max per the run-4 sizing lesson); the ν = 0/CNP stripe at high B may rail — accepted and excluded from FFT (a railed stripe is itself a gap marker). **Price** (run-5 timing cal, 1.17 s/pt at fast_delay 1.0 s): 97 × 150 s rows + 64 min total ramp = 5.1 h → **headline ≈ 5 h 45 m** (actuals run over estimates on this rig). **Checkpoints:** first rows (~10 min: rail/leak/sensitivity/co-sweep sanity), then interim FFT reads at ~2.5 T (row ~55), ~4 T (row ~75), ~6.5 T (row ~88) — continue/abort with the fan readable from partial data at every stage since low-B rows land first.

# === Landau fan at D = 0 (`landau-fan`): n -1.25 -> +3.25e12 (co-swept TG/BG line, run-5 cal), B 1.2 -> 10 T uniform in 1/B ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
n_vec = np.linspace(-1.25, 3.25, 121)           # 1e12 cm^-2, step 0.0375e12; D = 0 fixed
Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec = calc_gate_voltages(n_vec, 0.0, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert Vtg_vec.min() >= TG_MIN and Vtg_vec.max() <= TG_MAX, (Vtg_vec.min(), Vtg_vec.max())
assert Vbg_vec.min() >= BG_MIN and Vbg_vec.max() <= BG_MAX, (Vbg_vec.min(), Vbg_vec.max())
print(f"fast axis: n {n_vec[0]:+.3f} -> {n_vec[-1]:+.3f} e12 ({len(n_vec)} pts); "
      f"Vtg [{Vtg_vec.min():+.4f}, {Vtg_vec.max():+.4f}] V, Vbg [{Vbg_vec.min():+.4f}, {Vbg_vec.max():+.4f}] V")

# --- slow axis: B uniform in 1/B (SdH-periodic axis; hands sdh_fft an even record), ascending from where the magnet sits ---
B_vec = np.round(1.0 / np.linspace(1.0 / 1.2, 1.0 / 10.0, 97), 4)
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP
du = abs(np.diff(1.0 / B_vec)).max()
print(f"slow axis: B {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T, {len(B_vec)} rows uniform-1/B; d(1/B) = {du:.5f} -> F_Nyq {0.5/du:.0f} T, dF_res {1/(1/B_vec[0]-1/B_vec[-1]):.2f} T")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05: handoff left 0 T), V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), "
      f"PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()

I_TRIP = 1e-9
# Sensitivity 100 uV = 10 kOhm FS at 10 nA: 17x the observed high-B 1D max (run 7: 590 Ohm at 10 T) per the
# run-4 lesson (size >= 10x). The nu=0/CNP stripe at high B may still rail — accepted, excluded from FFT.
sr1.sensitivity(100e-6)
print(f"sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V, tau {sr1.time_constant()} s, slope {sr1.filter_slope()} dB/oct; "
      f"fast_delay 1.0 s (3.3 tau, run-5-proven quasi-continuous gate steps), magnet settle_s {magnet.settle_s} s")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = ("landau-fan: D = 0 line (run-5 cal), n -1.25 -> +3.25e12 121 pts co-swept TG/BG; "
                  "B 1.2 -> 10 T uniform-1/B 97 rows; Vsi = 0; sr1 100 uV")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan')
s.add_comment(f'D = 0 fan: n {n_vec[0]:+.3f} -> {n_vec[-1]:+.3f}e12 cm^-2 (121 pts), fast = [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt] co-swept; '
              f'B {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T (97 rows uniform in 1/B, d(1/B) {du:.5f}); '
              f'cal run 5: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_vec[0]); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_vec[0])
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B, Vtg, Vbg, T_sample, i_tg, i_bg, sr0_X, sr0_P, sr1_X, sr1_P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X); s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.3f} V: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec],
                 slow_delay=3.0, fast_delay=1.0)
# ends at 10 T with the gates at n = +3.25e12 — no park; the next step decides the ride-down.
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f}), T = {T_sample():.3f} K")

> **01:33** · sdh-spot-check e-side: n=+3.2e12 D=0 (Vtg +0.984, Vbg +1.166), B 0->10 T, 50 mT to 1 T then 10 mT, delay 0 (3 s settle), sr1 50 uV; ends at 10 T · **ETA ~03:48** (≈2h15m)

Calibration from run 5 (ana): c_bg/c_tg = 0.773 (data), c_tg = 2.796 mF/m² (9.5 nm prior), n_offset −0.089×10¹², D_offset −0.013 V/nm (R_CNP(D) symmetry). The D = 0 line inside the validators spans n = −1.27 … +3.27×10¹², so the electron side is the high-|n| side: spot at **n = +3.2×10¹²** → (V_tg, V_bg) = (+0.984, +1.166) V, 16 mV under the TG limit. **Feasibility (Step 2, model table):** F_L = 33.1 T; ABAB pair ≈ 7.5 / 25.6 T (m* 0.028 / 0.061 mₑ), ABCA singleton 33.1 T (m* 0.074); the heavy-ABAB-vs-ABCA split is 7.5 T. Grid: uniform in B (blocking magnet) — 50 mT from 0 to 1 T (MR background only; LK at T_e ≈ 8 K kills m* = 0.06 below ~1.5 T), **10 mT from 1 to 10 T**; 921 points. Dwell: `delay = 0` — each `magnet.field` set blocks through the ramp plus the driver's 3 s settle = 10 τ at τ = 0.3 s / 24 dB, i.e. the lock-in is at the settling floor at every point. Sensitivity fixed at 50 µV (5 kΩ FS): R(B = 0) ≈ 70 Ω is 1.4 % of range, but there is no SdH below ~1.5 T and the MR + SdH maxima at high B need the headroom; the FFT window starts above onset. **Price:** 10 T bare traverse 73 min + 921 × ~3.8 s per-point overhead (settle 3 s + reads) ≈ 58 min → **≈ 2 h 15 m**, ending at **10 T with the gates at the spot** — the hole-side spot check (n = −1.2×10¹²) then rides the magnet down 10 → 0.3 T, never re-traversing. Checkpoints: first 20 points (signal, sensitivity, leakage, field readback tracking setpoints); at ~3 T and ~6 T a partial FFT on the landed record (onset, tone count) — abort if the channel rails or no oscillation content has appeared by 6 T with R flat (then the fan is pointless at this T_e and the read is resolution-limited).
